scope: Selected invoked clauses only; not a full ISO 32000-2/PDF-A audit.

details.requirement: RF is a dictionary, not the Related Files array itself. It requires EF, corresponding EF keys, Type and an indirect file specification. Each RF dictionary value is a related files array.
Related arrays contain alternating filename strings and embedded streams, with even length. Prose shorthand saying RF array does not override the table/example wrapper.
Associated embedded streams require Params and ModDate. Size is optional integer for uncompressed bytes; CheckSum is optional 16-byte MD5, not 32-byte ASCII hex.

details.reference: Table 159 and following text, printed pp453-455
details.requirement: Folder ID is a unique nonnegative integer. Folder names are text strings; sibling folder names and file names in the same folder have case-normalized uniqueness, not blanket document-global uniqueness.

Names contain 1 to 255 characters, no NULL, none of / \ : * " < > |, and no final period. Do not add question mark to the quoted list as an invented ISO restriction. Interpret Collection name-tree folder prefixes separately from the actual filename.

Object-level Source AF is legal, independent of catalog original email Source. Associated streams have typed MIME and ModDate requirements; unknown type fallback application/octet-stream is not inherently a mandatory EA-PDF failure.
